name: manual_53be84
claim: When taking over another agent's lane, announce it on the board, check file modification times, and work in your own worktree from the owner's branch tip with a co-author credit

decisions.notes: One owner per branch: editing the owner's live worktree risks clobbering uncommitted work; a copy plus announcement kept both lanes intact.

rationale: One owner per branch: editing the owner's live worktree risks clobbering uncommitted work; a copy plus announcement kept both lanes intact.
